items.title: Meta spend 2026-09-22 to 09-28: $327.77, 19 leads, CPL $17.25
items.summary: Flooring Problems Campaign was the only campaign with delivery, spending $327.77 for 19 leads (221 clicks, 9,936 impressions) over the 7-day window. Account is ACTIVE with no flagged ads.

needs_attention: Window widened to 7 days (2026-09-22 to 09-28): last prior meta-ads.json was 2026-09-08, a gap over 7 days (capped). Metrics are 7-day totals, not yesterday only; 09-09 to 09-21 is not covered.
No separate CPL baseline pull was made, so no anomaly comparison was run; the 7-day window is the baseline. CPL $17.25 is well under the $50/day budget pace.
